import subprocess
code = '''
import sys, resource
data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
sys.path.insert(0, \"/app/submission\")
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"m\", \"/app/submission/main.py\")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
class FakeIn:
    def __init__(self, b): self.buffer = __import__(\"io\").BytesIO(b)
sys.stdin = FakeIn(data)
import io
sys.stdout = io.StringIO()
m.main()
peak = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
sys.stderr.write(\"peak RSS %.1f MiB\\\\n\" % (peak/1024.0))
'''
p = subprocess.run(['python3','-c',code], stdin=open('big_brackets.json','rb'), capture_output=True)
